name: App Flowy
description: AppFlowy is a workspace app for notes, docs, and projects, and an open-source alternative to Notion. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys AppFlowy as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Workspace app, an alternative to Notion. Self-host AppFlowy on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
